questions.text_en: What ZIP code are you in now?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué código postal se encuentra ahora?
questions.help_en: This routes you to the correct county and local application options. A general ZIP is enough; a street address is not needed.
questions.help_es: Esto le dirige al condado y a las opciones locales correctas. Un código postal es suficiente; no se necesita una dirección.
questions.why_asked: Used once for county routing and local program links.
questions.conditional_note: Reused automatically if the person already entered a ZIP in the immediate food finder.
source_refs: County routing and residency desk aids

questions.help_en: Age can change WIC, Restaurant Meals, student, and other program routes.

questions.text_en: How many people are in your CalFresh food household?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuántas personas forman parte de su hogar de CalFresh?
questions.help_en: Usually include people who live together and buy and prepare food together. Spouses and children under 22 living with a parent generally must be together. An authorized worker makes the final household determination.
questions.why_asked: Selects the correct income threshold and household calculation.
questions.conditional_note: Use the help text rather than asking every relationship question up front.

questions.text_en: About how much gross income does the food household receive in a month, before taxes?
questions.text_es: Aproximadamente, ¿cuánto ingreso bruto recibe el hogar al mes antes de impuestos?
questions.help_en: An estimate is enough for this pre-screen. Official workers review income frequency, exclusions, and deductions.
questions.why_asked: Supports the CalFresh gross-income screen and expedited-service indicator.
questions.conditional_note: Do not ask for documents during pre-screening.

questions.text_en: Are you enrolled at least half-time in a college or other institution of higher education?
questions.text_es: ¿Está inscrito al menos a medio tiempo en una institución de educación superior?
questions.help_en: A special student rule may apply. If no, student-exemption questions are skipped.
questions.why_asked: Determines whether the CalFresh student restriction needs review.
questions.conditional_note: Only student-specific follow-ups should appear after Yes.

questions.text_en: Does a school meal plan provide more than half of your meals?
questions.text_es: ¿Un plan de comidas escolar proporciona más de la mitad de sus comidas?
questions.help_en: This is only used when the half-time student rule applies.
questions.why_asked: A majority meal plan can change the food-household route.
questions.conditional_note: Ask only when student_half_time is Yes.

questions.text_en: Do any of these student exceptions describe you?
questions.text_es: ¿Alguna de estas excepciones para estudiantes le describe?
questions.help_en: Select every option that may apply. A county worker verifies the final exception.

options.label_en: Working at least 20 hours per week / 80 hours per month
options.label_es: Trabajo al menos 20 horas por semana

options.label_en: Approved for work-study and expect to participate
Responsible for a child under age 6
options.label_es: Responsable de un niño menor de 6 años

options.label_en: Responsible for a child age 6–11 without adequate child care
options.label_es: Responsable de un niño de 6 a 11 años sin cuidado adecuado

options.label_en: Single parent, full-time student, with a child under 12
options.label_es: Padre/madre soltero, estudiante de tiempo completo, con hijo menor de 12

options.label_en: Disability or otherwise unfit for employment
options.label_es: Discapacidad o no apto para empleo
Menor de 18 o de 50 años o más
En un programa aprobado de capacitación/empleo

questions.why_asked: Checks the most common shared student exemptions without separate forms.
questions.conditional_note: Ask only when student_half_time is Yes.

questions.text_en: About how much cash and money in checking or savings is available to the household right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánto dinero en efectivo y en cuentas está disponible ahora?
questions.help_en: This is used only for the expedited CalFresh indicator, not as a general asset test for most applicants.
questions.why_asked: One of the expedited-service tests uses immediately available liquid resources.
questions.conditional_note: Ask after basic routing, not before showing food.

questions.text_en: About how much does the household pay each month for rent, mortgage, or shelter?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánto paga el hogar al mes por alquiler, hipoteca o refugio?
questions.help_en: An estimate is used only for the expedited-service comparison and later deduction guidance.
questions.why_asked: Can identify crisis households and is reusable for deduction guidance.

questions.text_en: About how much does the household pay each month for utilities?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánto paga el hogar al mes por servicios públicos?
questions.help_en: An estimate is enough for the expedited comparison. Official budgeting uses standardized utility allowances.

questions.text_en: Is anyone in the household a migrant or seasonal farmworker with very little money available now?
questions.text_es: ¿Alguien en el hogar es trabajador agrícola migrante o de temporada con muy poco dinero disponible?
questions.help_en: This can activate a separate expedited-service test.
questions.why_asked: A separate expedited criterion applies to some migrant/seasonal farmworker households.
questions.conditional_note: Ask only after immediate resources are shown.

questions.text_en: Does anyone in the household currently receive CalFresh?
questions.text_es: ¿Alguien en el hogar recibe CalFresh actualmente?
questions.help_en: This affects Restaurant Meals routing and can prevent duplicate application guidance.
questions.why_asked: Reused by Restaurant Meals and application-routing logic.
questions.conditional_note: Does not require a case number.

questions.text_en: Which best describes where you are staying?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál describe mejor dónde se está quedando?
questions.help_en: This can improve food routing and Restaurant Meals screening. A fixed address is not required for CalFresh.

options.label_en: Outside / vehicle / place not meant for housing

questions.why_asked: Supports access mode, expedited context, and RMP routing.

questions.text_en: Does anyone in the CalFresh household have a disability that may affect program rules?
questions.text_es: ¿Alguien en el hogar tiene una discapacidad que pueda afectar las reglas?
questions.help_en: This may affect Restaurant Meals, deductions, household rules, and later work-rule review.
questions.conditional_note: Do not ask for diagnosis or documentation in the demo.

questions.text_en: Is anyone pregnant or recently pregnant?
questions.text_es: ¿Alguien está embarazada o estuvo embarazada recientemente?
questions.help_en: This can open a WIC route and may affect other rules.

questions.text_en: Does the household include a child under age five?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un niño menor de cinco años en el hogar?
questions.help_en: This can open a WIC route.

questions.text_en: Which benefits does anyone in the household currently receive?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué beneficios recibe actualmente alguien en el hogar?
questions.help_en: Select only what you know. This can reduce duplicate questions later.
questions.why_asked: Can simplify future adjunctive-eligibility and application flows.
questions.conditional_note: Not required for the current core screen.

questions.text_en: Have you served in the U.S. military?
questions.text_es: ¿Ha servido en las Fuerzas Armadas de los Estados Unidos?
questions.help_en: Some future veteran-specific services may use this answer. The current food pilot will not ask it unless an active program needs it.
questions.why_asked: Reusable signal for future veteran-specific services.
questions.conditional_note: Dormant until an approved active program references veteran_status.

questions.text_en: Have you ever been in foster care?
questions.text_es: ¿Ha estado alguna vez en cuidado de crianza?
questions.help_en: Some youth and former-foster-youth programs may use this answer. The current food pilot will not ask it unless an active program needs it.
questions.why_asked: Reusable signal for future foster-youth services.
questions.conditional_note: Dormant until an approved active program references foster_care_history.
